solution:
The complex ion has charge $+2$. If the oxidation state of Co is $x$, then $x-1=+2$, so $x=+3$.
The ligands are named alphabetically as ammine and chlorido; the counter-ion is chloride.
Hence, the name is pentaamminechloridocobalt(III) chloride.
